title: Decision matching in pack is calibrated on real decisions
goal: Once the kb holds real decisions, the pack's decision match (60% of the question's informative words plus every name, at most 3 lines and a third of the budget) and kbdecide sweep's relink cut (difflib 0.5) are measured over them and lookup_eval rows, and each threshold is kept or changed on that evidence.
notes: Kept as a draft: kb/_self/_decisions.csv holds no decision row yet, so there is nothing to calibrate on; start when real decisions exist.
